paper_metadata.title: Microstructure and tensile properties of orthorhombic Ti–Al–Nb–Ta alloys

evidence.quote: Microstructure and tensile properties of orthorhombic Ti–Al–Nb–Ta alloys have been studied.

In this present work, the microstructure and tensile properties of orthorhombic alloys in the Ti–Al–Nb–Ta alloy system were studied to determine whether substituting part of Nb by Ta can improve the tensile properties of orthorhombic alloys.
The alloys with the nominal composition of Ti–22Al–24Nb–3Ta and Ti–22Al–20Nb–7Ta (at%) respectively, were prepared by induction skull melting (ISM)

Comparing to the Ti–22Al–27Nb alloy, it was found that the addition of Ta to an orthorhombic alloy refines the prior b grains, and is beneficial to the formation of fine O phase laths and particles during the following thermal deformation and the subsequent heat treatment.
